# Lorenz Espinosa — AI Systems & Automation Architect

> Independent AI systems & automation architect for ops-heavy businesses. Builds reliable, self-hosted automation on n8n: fixes the broken process and cuts SaaS/subscription bloat first, then adds AI exactly where it earns its keep — gated with evals, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop. Track record: 50+ operational processes automated and $800K+ in hard-dollar client savings. Fully remote, worldwide.

## About
- Role: AI Systems & Automation Architect (independent / freelance)
- Approach: fix the process first, self-hosted and private, deterministic core, AI only where it earns its keep. No tool sprawl, no AI slop, nothing that hallucinates into business-critical work.
- Background: 5 years in IT, Windows Server, and AWS before specializing in automation; concurrent year-long engagement with Le Cordon Bleu International (IT infrastructure + marketing automation).

## Services
- Automation & Cost Audit — map workflows, find highest-ROI automations, flag overlapping tools and SaaS overspend (starts ~$750).
- Build & Ship — fixed-scope automation built end-to-end: trigger, validate, process, integrate, audit log (from $2,500).
- AI Agents & Orchestration — production agents wired to real tools, gated by human approval, with evals and guardrails.
- Fractional Automation Engineering — ongoing ownership of the automation backlog (retainer from $1,500/month).

## Proof / outcomes
- 50+ operational processes automated across intake, case and record management, billing, and client communication.
- $800K+ in hard-dollar client savings.
- +30% lead conversion on a capped AI budget; -70% manual data entry on a 3-system intake pipeline; zero missed invoices on a deterministic billing sync.
